text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can't stop smiling! The way we
totally won
the class relay at the Fan
Fest was just! So!
FUUUUN!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...This again?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, I can't get it off my mind!
Especially
the huge smile you had when
we won the
four-legged race together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! I-I don't know what you're talking
about!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I won't downplay our trio's
teamwork, but
I've also got to give
credit where it's due.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The one who truly led us to victory was
our class
representative.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? M-me? But I wasn't even in the
relay.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know, but you put in a lot of work
behind the
scenes to make sure
everyone's unique talents
could shine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: All right, here comes the four-legged race! Let's all cheer on BNW like we mean it! Ready, set, cheer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Our class was able to do our best
because of your
humble, dedicated
support.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And not just the Fan Fest! Our
whole class
is such great friends 'cause
of all the fun stuff you
plan for us!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You always, *sniffle*... alwaysh... do sho mujch for ush!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAH! You're the best class rep
eveeeer!
Thamk you sho muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Aww!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You guys are the best classmates ever!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so, SO flattered, Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With you cheering me on, I'm gonna
keep on
bein' the best I can be! I'll work
even harder and
harder!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You work way too hard as it is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Narita Top Road hauling
around
a heavy-looking box.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whew! So, I've just gotta get this over to
the
training room, right?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, but are you sure you'll be
okay carrying
it by yourself? It's full of
weights for strength
training, so it's got
to be awfully heavy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm totally fine! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The girls in class were super excited that
we'd be
getting new equipment, so I
can't wait to deliver
it all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll zip over right now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll zip over right now!
choice_data_list: You should really get someone to help you...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I appreciate the offer, but this
box is
suuuper heavy, so don't worry
about it!
choice_data_list: You should really get someone to help you...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why they're offering...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ayabe?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...And I completely agree.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ayabe?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...See, I knew this'd happen. Ayabe, put
the box
down over here and let's split
the stuff between
us.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'll help too! Lemme carry
something!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You guys don't have to...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aw, c'mon! Remember the relay?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You always do so much for all of us, so
we wanna
do lots to help you too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're happy to pitch in anytime,
anywhere, so
never feel like you've
gotta push yourself too
hard, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'd really appreciate a
hand,
everyone!
